== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster replaces the original profession bonuses with forfeit protection for low-ability aliens, with a Molator exception. The lore-based activation becomes a qualifying battle destiny bonus. It adds an option to raise a converted site and drops Alter immunity.
